posts.text: I am incredibly honoured to share that I have received the Western Gold Medal from Western University The Western Gold Medal is awarded to the student with the highest average in their program, and I received it for Honours Specialization in Computer Science. Looking back, I’m proud of everything I was able to accomplish during my time at Western.
